name: Christoph
source:
Christoph is the mysterious boy with white hair and white eyes who is presumed to be a pure-blooded Vanan. Lance had been hiding him in a hidden underground room in the backstreets of the town due to him being targeted for his rare hair and eye color. People from the House of Vanum are targeting him due to him having pure white hair and eyes which fables say are the features of a pure-blooded Vanan. 

[From [url=https://court-of-darkness.fandom.com/wiki/Christoph]Fandom Wiki[/url]]
